description: A bright blue rubber-tyred train with dual wheel bogies stands at a platform in a vaulted concrete station with arches. Commuters in 1950s-60s overcoats and fedora-style hats crowd the platform and board the doors. Colourful abstract mosaic murals decorate the walls, and steel rails run in the foreground. No visible text, signature or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
